title: Every outside dollar in this race, as squares — animated
description: Looping animation of the site’s unit-grid: 34 red squares (each = $1 opposing Platner) pop in one at a time; the single green square ($1 supporting) lands last and pulses; ends on “$11,077,173 vs $323,426 — a 34 : 1 gap.”
alt_text: Animation: a grid fills one square at a time with 34 red squares, each representing one dollar spent opposing Platner. A single green square, one dollar supporting him, appears last and pulses. Ends stating $11,077,173 versus $323,426, a 34 to 1 gap.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Data visualization compiled from public FEC filings and cited press reporting. Figures: $11,077,173 spent opposing Graham Platner vs. $323,426 supporting (FEC Schedule E, deduplicated, Oct 2025 – Jul 8, 2026).
accessibility_note: First frame is near-empty; pair with the static ig-1080x1080.png where a meaningful preview frame is required.
